dedupe_keys.name: cied chinese industrial emissions database pm so2 and nox from cems 2015 to 2018

description: The Chinese Industrial Emissions Database is an inventory of particulate matter, sulphur dioxide and nitrogen oxide emissions from Chinese industry for 2015 to 2018. It is built from direct measurements in China's continuous emission monitoring systems (CEMS) network. The figshare collection (version 2, 12 February 2023) holds five Excel files, each also a figshare dataset: absolute emissions, activity data, emission factors and stack gas concentrations by industrial emission source, plus an additional description of subcategories, flue gas rates and an uncertainty comparison. Coverage is national for China, split by industrial source category; the page read gives no plant-level coordinates. Access is free on figshare under CC BY 4.0, and the files are small (under 200 KB each). The authors are Ling Tang, Min Jia, Junai Yang, Ling Li, Xin Bo and Zhifu Mi. Caveats: it covers only plants in the CEMS network and the years 2015 to 2018, and the method paper was not read here. For simulation it gives emission factors and stack concentrations of Chinese industry for environmental impact and air-quality scenarios, such as emission changes when plants shut down or restart after a disaster. Related catalogue records include the European Industrial Emissions Portal, the EPA Toxics Release Inventory and the EPA Greenhouse Gas Reporting Program.
